design.rewrite: county-equality Hash Join, city side NOT MATERIALIZED
design.whyThisNotUnMaterializeBoth: NOT MATERIALIZED on parcels_six inlines 1M GeoJSON decodes. If the join stayed Nested Loop those decodes would run per city (~846M). That is a classifier dodge that can make the timeout worse. Rejected.
design.whyThisNotGiST: GiST needs an index on a relation. CREATE INDEX is refused by the RO file-side guard. TEMP is forbidden. Base geometry is GeoJSON text, not an indexed geography column.
design.whyThisNotEnableNestloopOff: Hash Join still requires an equality clause. enable_nestloop=off without equality errors with could not devise a query plan. A GUC is not a join rewrite.
design.mechanism: PostgreSQL Hash Join requires at least one equality in hashclauses. The poison join has none (west/east/south/north inequalities plus ST_Intersects), so the method set is Nested Loop only. Adding p.county_fips = c.county_fips puts an equality into hashclauses. Hash Join enters the set. Cost of Nested Loop without an index is the measured 1.06e10; Hash Join is O(n+m) with cities_ok as the build side.
design.cities_ok: NOT MATERIALIZED bind, not a hint. Inlined. EXPLAIN cannot emit CTE Scan on cities or CTE Scan on cities_ok. isMillionRowCteNestedLoop requires that city CTE Scan as conjunct three. The poison shape is unrepresentable even if a small Nested Loop remains inside the hash build (city x 6 counties).
design.parcels_six: stays MATERIALIZED. Decode once. 01 references it twice (parcel_hits and parcel_jurisdiction).
design.counties: MATERIALIZED, six FIPS only. 811 x 6 bbox+intersects is the cheap city-county join already measured at 1.3s statewide (1222 x 254). Name is counties, not cities, so CTE Scan on counties does not trip the classifier.
design.cities_ok_rows: one row per (city, county) pair that intersects a six-county polygon. FROM cities_ok c JOIN parcels_six p kept so requireZoneMajor still matches.
design.semanticRisk: A parcel whose ring leaves its county_fips and hits a city that does not intersect that county polygon would miss. DISTINCT ON already binds the parcel to one county_fips. Sliver city-county pairs that 1e-8 would drop on 03 still hash here (bare ST_Intersects on city-county) so a parcel-city hit above 1e-8 is not lost. If TOTALS move, the join is wrong; do not adopt a new split.
